# The Society of Daves

> A parody members' club for people called Dave, with accurate information about the name Dave/David. Membership costs $1 a month and includes The Dave Dispatch, a monthly email newsletter about the name Dave.

Key facts:
- Dave is short for David, from the Hebrew Dawid, usually translated as "beloved".
- David was the most popular US boys' name in 1960 (85,929 births, SSA data). It peaked in the 1950s and ranked 31st in 2024.
- St David's Day, for the patron saint of Wales, is on 1 March.
- Membership: $1/month via Stripe, cancel any time at https://societyofdaves.com/api/manage. Contact: hello@societyofdaves.com.
- Gift memberships: $6 for 6 months or $12 for 12 months, paid once, delivered by email on Christmas Day or a chosen date: https://societyofdaves.com/gift
- Gift ideas for someone called Dave or David (personalised, funny, last-minute, by budget): https://societyofdaves.com/blog/gifts-for-daves/

## Articles
- [Why is D called David in Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2?](https://societyofdaves.com/blog/why-is-d-called-david-cyberpunk-edgerunners-2/): D, the netrunner in Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2, is also called David. Here is who he is, why the name matters, and how he mirrors David Martinez from the first series. Spoilers.
- [Gifts for Dave: 30 gift ideas for anyone called Dave or David](https://societyofdaves.com/blog/gifts-for-daves/): The best gifts for someone called Dave or David: personalised, funny and last-minute ideas, sorted by type of Dave and by budget, from a $6 gift membership to a trip to Florence.
- [What does the name Dave mean? Is Dave short for David?](https://societyofdaves.com/blog/what-does-the-name-dave-mean/): Yes, Dave is short for David, a Hebrew name usually translated as "beloved". Here is where the name comes from, how it spread, and how Dave became the default nickname.
- [How many Davids are there in the world? The name David in numbers](https://societyofdaves.com/blog/how-popular-is-the-name-david/): About 13.4 million people worldwide are called David, making it the 13th most common first name on Earth. Plus a century of US data: number one in 1960, 31st in 2024.
- [Famous Daves: the most notable people called Dave and David](https://societyofdaves.com/blog/famous-daves/): From David Bowie and David Attenborough to Dave Grohl and Michelangelo's statue: the notable Daves in music, TV, film, art, sport and history.
- [David in Welsh is Dafydd: David in other languages, from Dewi to Dawud](https://societyofdaves.com/blog/david-in-other-languages/): David in Welsh is Dafydd (said "DAH-vith"), or Dewi for Saint David, and Dai for short. Plus David in Scottish Gaelic, Italian, Polish, Arabic, Hawaiian and more.
- [When is St David's Day 2027? Monday 1 March, plus 10 facts about Saint David](https://societyofdaves.com/blog/st-davids-day/): St David's Day is on 1 March every year; in 2027 that's a Monday. What the day is, 10 facts about Saint David, why the Welsh wear daffodils and leeks, and how to celebrate.
